Chuang Tzu's butcher carves the lesson that the effortless path (the straightforward shot) is the skilled one, and Lao Tzu's sage-leadership—lowering oneself, deflecting praise—is exactly how Captain America handles Clint's insurrections. Lao Tzu on sages putting themselves last illuminates Hawkeye's sacrificial death and his legacy passed to Kate Bishop, while the butterfly dream frames his resurrection and the House of M's rewritten reality: with no way to compare the states, life and death are both to be welcomed as parts of the Way.

samples.book: 181 - Ultimate Lost and Philosophy - Think Together, Die Alone
samples.title: NOTE
samples.relation: Shai Biderman and William Devlin argue the character John Locke begins as an empiricist in the mold of his philosophical namesake - his boar hunting, tracking, and trebuchet-building against the hatch all follow the scientific method befitting a tabula rasa mind furnished by experience - but the miracle of his healed legs poses a 'why' that empirical explanation of 'how' cannot answer. He therefore converts to the Taoism of the Tao Te Ching: the moth-cocoon lesson to Charlie, 'I stopped looking' for Sun's ring, reading dreams and signs from the island, and finally his self-sacrifice to stop the time flashes all enact following the Way. The chapter reads the black-and-white backgammon stones, Locke's one-black-one-white eyes in Claire's dream, and Jacob versus the Man in Black as yin-yang complementarity, with empiricism and Taoism finally interdependent like the dots in each half.

samples.book: 005 - The Lord of the Rings and Philosophy - One Book to Rule Them All
samples.title: The Lord of the Rings and Philosophy
samples.relation: Jennifer McMahon and Steve Csaki compare Tolkien with Zen Buddhism and Taoism on four themes while insisting on the real differences. Tolkien's talking trees (Old Man Willow, Treebeard's 'half awake' forest) invite comparison with Buddhist universal sentience and Dogen's walking mountains, but Tolkien anthropomorphizes where Buddhism grants non-human modes of sentience; the hobbits' ties to the Shire echo dependent origination, though Tolkien's stewardship and preference for the domesticated Shire over sinister wild nature remain Western. Frodo's succession of mentors (Bilbo, Gandalf, Aragorn, and the unlikely 'Master Samwise') parallels the Zen master-student relation, while Tolkien's war of light against darkness - nine Walkers against nine Riders - is decisively not the Taoist balance of yin and yang, for Taoists destroying either cosmic force would itself produce evil.

samples.book: 018 - Harley-Davidson and Philosophy - Full-Throttle Aristotle
samples.title: Harley-Davidson and Philosophy
samples.relation: Jones narrates a day riding a customized Sportster around O'ahu as a lived Daoism that heals the Platonic-Cartesian mind-body split: the ride enacts Zhuangzi's 'rambling without destination' and Cook Ding's effortless wu-wei, rider li (the low hand-greeting among riders) is Confucian ritual propriety, and the island's dry and wet ranges embody yin and yang through whose flow the rider blends. Heraclitus's 'expect the unexpected' and 'the sun is new every day' are vindicated when a container truck stops short and only the disciplined, ego-less low-side, dropping the beloved bike while riding the skid, saves the rider's life, sealing the day's lesson that there is never freedom without discipline. Sartre's hell of other people appears in the cagers' compartmentalized inattention, and the chapter closes with Zhuangzi: 'The way is made by walking it.'

samples.book: 107 - Deadpool and Philosophy - My Common Sense Is Tingling
samples.title: 27. The Mystic with the Mouth
samples.relation: In a lecture Deadpool keeps interrupting, the chapter reads the Merc's violence through Bataille's Theory of Religion: sacrifice as the search for lost intimacy, killing as the moment sacrificer and victim escape the profane world of mere things into sacred immanence, and sovereignty as the freedom glimpsed in destruction, with Rudolf Otto's mysterium tremendum et fascinans naming the awe Deadpool's massacres (the Circle Chase nunchuks, the Ultimate cartoon, the movie's highway slaughter) provoke. His 'dark Dao' of unhappy wandering is then set against the playful ways of the Zhuangzi - Cook Ding's ox-butchering, the Peng bird, the maimed teacher Wang Tai - as a Daoist path of inner-worldly transcendence that is amoral and gore-soaked. The payoff is the human tension of being both animal and angel: Deadpool is 'a savage god of mystical mayhem.'

samples.book: 019 - Monty Python and Philosophy - Nudge Nudge, Think Think!
samples.title: And Now for . . . Comedic Eliminativism
samples.relation: Argues The Meaning of Life dismantles the 'axial' picture of life as a journey toward a salvific destination (Jaspers's Axial Age thinking), instanced in the headmaster who announces Jenkins's mother's death between Empire Day announcements, the tank fish who never connect Howard's being eaten to their own fate, and the restaurant couple ordering 'philosophy for two' with no appetite for wisdom. The classical answers all fail as delivered: Socrates's philosophy as learning how to die, Heidegger's claim that facing death reveals one's own unique possibilities, and Kant's three questions (What can I know? What should I do? For what may I hope?) collapse into the question of life's meaning, but religion has gone stale and philosophy has become detached trivia. The Pythons instead accomplish the user-friendly domestication of the death of God — the hearty laughter Nietzsche and Derrida counsel — and the chapter coins 'comedic eliminativism' on the model of eliminative materialism's dissolution of Descartes's mind-body problem: replace the yearning for the meaning of life with altered reactions, laughter itself as the solution to the riddle.

samples.book: 041 - Stephen Colbert and Philosophy - I Am Philosophy (And So Can You!)
samples.title: Under-Confidence in Reason Once It’s Easier Said, then It’s Done
samples.relation: Roben Torosyan turns Colbert into a negative textbook for critical thinking: the character embodies the exact opposite of the American Philosophical Association's seven critical-thinking dispositions (inquisitive, open-minded, truthseeking, systematic, analytical, judicious, confident in reason), from refusing to imagine Lisa Randall's extra dimensions, to 'the market doesn't lie' about the Bible, to placing himself above Maimonides, Socrates, and Aquinas in the stem-cell Formidable Opponent. Each section names the fallacies his shtick commits - appeal to popularity, appeal to ignorance, composition, circular reasoning, wishful thinking, appeal to consequences - using real WØRD bits like the Iraq 'no casualties' monologue and the cake-metaphor exchange about the war. The WØRD's self-undermining bullet points are read as Derridean deconstruction (différance): every assertion shot through with what differs from and defers it. Watching Colbert fail at the examined life Socrates recommended, the viewer learns to catch such abuses in pundits and in themselves.

samples.book: 188 - The Ultimate South Park and Philosophy - Respect My Philosophah!
samples.title: THE ULTIMATE SOUTH PARK AND PHILOSOPHY
samples.relation: Young argues that South Park is perceived as dangerous for exactly the reasons Socrates was tried and executed in Plato's Apology: both 'corrupt the youth' by mocking religion, questioning authority, and exposing that the supposed teachers (Mr. Garrison's flip-flopping creationism, Mrs. Broflovski's moral panics, the 'Death' boycott of Terrance and Phillip) do not know what they think they know. He diagnoses Cartman as an Eichmann figure whose banal, thoughtless evil—feeding Scott Tenorman his parents, torturing Muslims with farts—consists in the inability to think from another's standpoint, while Kyle and Stan's friendship embodies Arendt's dialogic thinking and Aristotle's mean between ideological extremes, as when they see both the merit and the smugness of hybrid drivers in 'Smug Alert'. Freud's theory that jokes break through repression explains why the show's vulgarity is essential rather than gratuitous: it verbalizes what culture silences so that it can be thought through, making South Park a Socratic gadfly rather than a corrupter.

samples.book: 065 - Chuck Klosterman and Philosophy - The Real and the Cereal
samples.title: Chuck Klosterman and Philosophy
samples.relation: Vannatta explains why Seinfeld reruns now fall flat through Klosterman's neologism 'unironically': since about 1991 irony has become the invisible background of American comedy, a pervasive detachment that David Foster Wallace named and that Jedediah Purdy's For Common Things attacks as the gap between phenomenon and essence. Against Purdy's ironist (Seinfeld's Jerry, mastered by irony, believing in nothing but his own interests), the chapter sets Kierkegaard's Socrates, whose 'infinite absolute negativity' and confessing ignorance serve a truth he cannot define, and asks whether Klosterman, probing the gap between Bono's rehearsed car-ride persona and his inner self, is master of irony or mastered by it. The answer places Chuck midway between the two jailed ironists, Socrates and the Seinfeld finale: like Socrates he knows his own ignorance and serves the undefined idea of self-understanding, but only through pop-culture resemblance (KISS where Jerry used Superman), unable to master irony any more than he can bite his own teeth.

samples.book: 063 - Philip K. Dick and Philosophy - Do Androids Have Kindred Spirits
samples.title: Chapter 32 - “The Exit Door Leads In”
samples.relation: Eric Beck reads 'The Exit Door Leads In' as a modernized Platonic dialogue: like Oedipus before the Sphinx, the average salesman Bob Bibleman wins mandatory university admission by answering a computerized waiter's riddle, staging the Delphic 'Know Thyself' against Plato's Gorgias ideal of self-mastery, while Plato's Socrates in Charmides disclaims healthy self-knowledge. When Bibleman's terminal spills classified engine schematics, he decides not on universal principle but on what he thinks the authorities want; his honest answer that he would have handed them over anyway gets him expelled for failing a test he could not read, a double bind showing self-knowledge is contingent and situational. Dick thus revises knowing oneself as negotiation of the state's expectations rather than discovery of an essence, though the ending - Bibleman paying the computer after deciding not to - leaves open that he may one day rebel and need re-education.

samples.book: 016 - Hip-Hop and Philosophy - Rhyme 2 Reason
samples.title: From Rhyme to Reason This Shit Ain’t Easy
samples.relation: The editors' introduction argues that hip hop and philosophy are both street-born examinations of life in pursuit of wisdom: Socrates's elenchus is likened to MC lyrical battles and call-and-response (his interrogations compared to Rakim's technique, his execution for corrupting the youth to the fate of a controversial rapper), while Plato's philosopher-king parallels Kurtis Blow and Run-D.M.C. claiming thrones. After a Bronx hip-hop history sketch (Kool Herc, BDP's "The Bridge is Over"), they frame the volume around hip hop's suppressed fifth element of knowledge and preview its pairings: Aquinas and Rakim on God, Plato and Lauryn Hill on love, Sartre and Lil' Kim's gaze, Kant and Ice Cube on punishment, Hegel and Nas, Hobbes and Dead Prez, Mill and Chappelle on epithets. Record companies don't own hip hop and universities don't own philosophy, they conclude - both belong to whoever understands, loves, and respects them.

samples.book: 173 - Inception and Philosophy - Because It's Never Just a Dream
samples.title: Group Will
samples.relation: Testerman argues the film's heist is ironic because nobody in it acts from conscious will: citing Libet's readiness-potential experiments and Penfield's stimulation cases, she claims the feeling of willing is a post-hoc 'epistemic illusion,' so Fischer's inception merely dramatizes what happens all the time — Cobb's 'all experience is inception' becomes a thesis about ordinary agency, with Spinoza's dictum that freedom is ignorance of the causes of our actions as its motto. She reads the plot through this lens: Saito's unexamined hunger for power silently drives the team's 'group will,' Cobb's 'positive emotion trumps negative emotion' tactic exploits the limbic system, and cheaper tricks (Arthur's elephant, foot-in-the-door, subliminal advertising) would have worked as well. Against Socrates she concludes the unexamined life is perfectly livable, since introspection can never reach the subconscious causes of behavior.

samples.book: 169 - The Hobbit and Philosophy - For When You've Lost Your Dwarves, Your Wizard, and Your Way
samples.title: a7.xhtml
samples.relation: The chapter sets the bloody classical ideal of glory (Homer's kleos, Beowulf, Alexander modeling himself on Achilles) - which Augustine already condemned as libido dominandi - against Plato's alternative of a life aimed at the good, the true and the beautiful. Thorin's last charge at the Battle of Five Armies fits the heroic tradition, but Tolkien's real point is that Bilbo, the 'grocer' who feels the dwarves' treasure-lust yet walks away from it, and who ends by inviting the dwarves to four-o'clock tea instead of a victory feast, shows glory subordinated to domestic beauty and humility. Socrates' question in the Apology - why care so little for wisdom and the soul's improvement while chasing wealth, honor and reputation - is exactly the temptation Bilbo resists, and the Symposium's move from battle to a drinking-party of love-of-beauty mirrors Tolkien's placement of heroism in hobbits rather than warriors.

samples.book: 028 - The Grateful Dead and Philosophy - Getting High Minded about Love and Haight
samples.title: Sometimes We Live No Particular Way but Our Own
samples.relation: Matthew Turner argues that a 'Playin' in the Band' jam — the band drifting from the tune into long collective improvisation and back — models a Stoic solution to free will shared by Epictetus, Spinoza, and Chuang Tzu: freedom is not uncaused choosing but responding well within constraints, so by the dichotomy of control there is no point resenting the band when it flubs a climax. Spinoza's definition of the free thing as one determined by its own nature, and Chuang Tzu's butcher who cuts oxen by spirit beyond skill, show the band letting the music 'play them' — Jerry's 'Tennessee Jed' riff never played the same way twice — as learned skill becomes second nature. Because the Dead jam within banks (keys, mutual listening, ability) yet generate something genuinely new and transcended every genre of 1960s music where the Monkees merely copied the Beatles, the Stoic attitude proves creative rather than quietist, an analogue for living freely within our own constraints.

samples.book: 178 - LEGO and Philosophy - Constructing Reality Brick by Brick
samples.title: Notes
samples.relation: Bein reads the LEGO brick as the Daodejing's 'uncarved block': a single brick is an invitation rather than a toy, and precisely because it is empty of meaning (and mostly empty of plastic — the stud-and-tube marriage of yin and yang) it can become anything, whereas printed, specialized pieces 'are diminished by being added to'. Against the Greek obsession with definition — Socrates refusing sophistry while insisting one cannot rule justly without defining justice, Plato's definition dialogues, Aristotle's inheritance of the precision ideal, and William James's 'think clearly' — Daoist imprecision is defended as a philosophical stance: dao is a way, an activity, not a thing. Wei wu wei ('doing without doing') explains Emmet's winning plan of building the utterly ordinary Octan spaceship, why Lord Business's penny-throw is genius without sagacity (coercive, not water-like), and why governing should be like cooking a small fish — minimal, attentive intervention.

samples.book: 141 - Avatar_ The Last Airbender and Philosophy - Wisdom from Aang to Zuko
samples.title: A Zhuangzian Sage All Along
samples.relation: Argues that Iroh's Book One laziness and foolishness is a Zhuangzian pose rather than genuine folly: like Zhuangzi's fictional Confucius counseling Yan Hui not to lecture the young, willful lord of Wei, Iroh never pressures Zuko directly, keeps himself unthreatening by playing the fool over tea and Pai Sho, and practices the 'use of uselessness' so he is never a tool of the prince's quest, 'singing' his wisdom only when Zuko is ready to hear it. The couple's falling out in 'Avatar Day', triggered precisely when Iroh offers explicit moral advice, confirms the strategy, since Zuko rejects both the advice and the uncle. The authors add an empirical study (Prolific participants rating clips): even viewers totally unfamiliar with the series rate Book One Iroh as wise and suspect his foolishness is strategic, supporting the interpretation that he is a Zhuangzian sage all along, and that ATLA in turn illuminates Zhuangzi's cryptic political advice.

samples.book: 018 - Harley-Davidson and Philosophy - Full-Throttle Aristotle
samples.title: Harley-Davidson and Philosophy
samples.relation: Priest argues that Pirsig's Zen and the Art of Motorcycle Maintenance is far more genuinely Zen than its disclaimer admits: once riding becomes effortless, the dissolution of the subject-object distinction that Dogen calls genjokoan arrives on the open road ('you ARE the driving and the road and the elements'), and the Harley's relaxed posture and low-revving thug-thug-thug rhythm make it a better vehicle for suchness than cars or whinier bikes. Even maintenance done as an end in itself is genjokoan, and because ultimate reality erases every conceptual distinction, care of self, others, and the bike amount to the same thing, the Mahayana ground of compassion; the mountain-and-water Zen saying resolves the paradox that the unconceptualized and the conceptualized are one. Suffering, on the Buddhist diagnosis Priest applies, comes from imposing conceptual grids that see the world wrong, and seeing it aright dissolves it.

samples.book: 142 - The Avengers and Philosophy - Earth's Mightiest Thinkers
samples.title: The Way of the Archer
samples.relation: White reads Clint Barton through the Tao Te Ching and Chuang Tzu: Hawkeye's instinctive archery—'use your bow gently, naturally, instinctively'—is wei wu wei, while his bragging, his glory-chasing failure against Iron Man, and his attempt to become Goliath all violate it by striving against his own nature, until the Kree-Skrull War teaches him the bow is his way. Chuang Tzu's butcher carves the lesson that the effortless path (the straightforward shot) is the skilled one, and Lao Tzu's sage-leadership—lowering oneself, deflecting praise—is exactly how Captain America handles Clint's insurrections. Lao Tzu on sages putting themselves last illuminates Hawkeye's sacrificial death and his legacy passed to Kate Bishop, while the butterfly dream frames his resurrection and the House of M's rewritten reality: with no way to compare the states, life and death are both to be welcomed as parts of the Way.

samples.book: 086 - Girls and Philosophy - This Book Isn't a Metaphor for Anything
samples.title: Girls and Philosophy
samples.relation: Carleo and D'Ambrosio read Hannah's 'busy trying to become who I am' through the classical Chinese debate over names: her self-claimed title 'writer' preceding any conduct is the Confucian nightmare of names divorced from actuality, diagnosed by the Analects's rectification of names ('rulers should rule, fathers should father') and the sheep-stealing passage warning against over-identifying with a single role. Adam, by contrast, lives the Daoist ideal - the empty vessel of the Daodejing acting by wu wei, and Zhuangzi's butterfly dream fluidity in his role-play sex and absorbed woodworking, unattached to titles. Mencius and Xunzi frame the resolution: by Season Three Hannah finally rectifies names at GQ while Adam's non-identity turns delusional, vindicating the ideal of being an 'internal sage and external king' - Daoist in private, responsible to roles in public.

samples.book: 163 - Game of Thrones and Philosophy - Logic Cuts Deeper Than Swords
samples.title: Game of Thrones and Philosophy
samples.relation: Arya's arc from Needle to answering 'No one' is read as Aristotelian virtue ethics fused with East Asian philosophy: virtues are habits acquired only through practice, so the Water Dance's endless drills and martial-arts blocks that must become automatic mirror the honest person who tells the truth without deliberating. Syrio's lessons - 'looking is not seeing,' the story of the ordinary tomcat the other bravos mistook for a fabulous beast, being fully present with your trouble - teach Zen seeing and mindfulness, while 'be like water' and the steel that must be part of your arm embody Laozi's effortless wu wei. The Faceless Men's initiation, from discarding her possessions to the literal removal of Arya's face, becomes the Zen slaying of the ego, making her a 'Zen-Ninja-Aristotelian' on the path to eudaimonia.

samples.book: 012 - Star Wars and Philosophy - More Powerful than You Can Possibly Imagine
samples.title: “Great Warrior Wars Not Make One Great”
samples.relation: Robinson (a Zen monk) argues the Force is best understood as ch'i and the Jedi path as philosophical Taoism and Zen: the Light and Dark Sides are the yin-yang polarity whose 'balance' Anakin's prophecy restores, and Anakin's fall is the Buddhist three poisons - clinging attachment to his mother and Padme breeding fear, anger, and hate. Yoda's teaching is Zen practice: 'You must unlearn what you have learned' is wu-wei (effortless action), 'Do or do not' rejects the divided mind of trying, and the Dagobah cave parallels the sword master Tesshu's koan insight that the real enemy is one's own mind ('no-enemy'). The chapter also traces Jedi genealogy to Bodhidharma's Shaolin kung-fu, the Korean Hwa Rang and Japanese Sohei warrior monks, and Bushido's samurai code, noting 'Jedi' derives from 'jidai geki'.
